question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A residence for nuns
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1** (Convent)'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **'A residence for nuns'** describes a building or a community in which nuns - women who have made special vows committing them to religious life - live together. (संन्यासिनीयों का निवास)
 
• The word **'Convent'** accurately substitutes this phrase.
 
• **A Convent** is a Christian community under monastic vows, specifically a one for nuns. ('नन्नियों का आवास)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- 'Option 1 **(Convent)'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2** 'Refugee'**, meaning a person who has been forced to leave their country to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster,(शरणार्थी)
 
• Option 3 **'Monastery'**, a building or buildings occupied by a community of monks living under religious vows, (मठ)
 
• Option 4 **'Mint',** a place where money is coined, especially under state authority,(टकसाल)
